key_insight: Persistent homology enables explicit control of connected components, holes, tunnels, and cavities in 2D and 3D isogeometric topology optimization.
engineering_relevance: Engineers can prescribe topology bounds while seeking mechanically competitive structural designs.
method: Compute persistence diagrams from a single sublevel filtration of a NURBS density field.
Apply staged, weighted topological objectives and remove redundant features by cutting or filling.
Derive analytical density-control sensitivities through topological inverse mapping and optimize using the method of moving asymptotes.
evidence_signal: Reported 2D and 3D benchmark experiments demonstrate reliable topology control, competitive mechanical performance, and stable convergence.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify computational overhead or sensitivity to the staged objective weights.
paper_title: Explicit topology control in isogeometric topology optimization using persistent homology
